summary: Independent review reproduced the issue-specific CancelledError escape at both tokenizer-manager disconnect polls on the recorded base. At the exact candidate commit, both branches converted receive-only cancellation into the existing per-request abort path, while explicit handler-task cancellation continued to propagate. A real single-gfx950 server also survived an abrupt TCP close and served a follow-up request. This is a source fix with regression coverage, not test-only hardening.

tests.what_was_measured: On base 358c163, receive-side CancelledError escaped from both waiting and running disconnect polls and abort_request had zero calls. Evidence: evidence/base-independent-repro.log.
At exact candidate e911ffa, all four candidate regressions passed: connected result, waiting abort, running abort, and genuine task-cancellation propagation.
Independently verified waiting and running aborts, connected false preservation, explicit external cancellation propagation including its message, and no polling for background requests.
Complete affected unit module: 30 tests and 3 subtests passed.
A real one-GPU SGLang server remained alive after abrupt TCP close, returned health 200, and completed a subsequent four-token GPU generation with output IDs [104, 40, 16, 93].

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950, using Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and Triton attention. Server log records GPU prefill/decode; probe.json records process survival, health 200, and follow-up output IDs [104, 40, 16, 93].

remaining_limitations: The exact four-GPU NVIDIA RTX 6000D SM120 deployment was unavailable; the review used one AMD gfx950 GPU.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash weights, the approximately 200,000-token prompt, TP=4 topology, and reported dev-dsv41 container image were unavailable, so the original deployment was not reproduced end to end.

The deterministic tiny Llama HTTP run validates transport and real engine survival only; it does not validate DeepSeek semantics, long-context behavior, NVIDIA-specific behavior, or distributed execution.
The real HTTP request completed quickly and did not log an is_disconnected CancelledError. Exact exception behavior was validated by deterministic injection at both affected source call sites.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
git diff --check on the candidate reports trailing whitespace in candidate archival log files; reviewed Python source and test additions are otherwise exercised by pytest.
